purpose: Teach: サックス/ダイビング/モデム/ロジック/スロット/エッチ/楽園/着席

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、ジャズ部でサックス吹いてんだろ?
lines.en: Riku, you play sax in the jazz club, right?
lines.style: Light, playful prod. Direct eye contact. Testing whether he'll actually answer or dodge. Quick pace, like she already knows the answer.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、夏休みダイビング行ったろ?桜
lines.en: You went diving over summer break, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Turning it back on her with calm precision. Not defensive—just steering. Cool exterior holding steady. Slight shift in his posture, like he's rebalancing.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、モデムって聞いたことあるか?
lines.en: Riku, have you ever heard of a modem?
lines.style: Sharp left turn in the conversation. Raised eyebrow quality. Genuinely curious what he'll do with this. Faster pace, like she's enjoying watching him scramble.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、ぼくの説明のロジック、おかしいって言うなよ、桜
lines.en: Don't start saying my explanation doesn't make sense, Sakura.
lines.style: Wry defensiveness wrapped around something genuine. Quiet laugh threaded through. He's seen this coming. Slight self-deprecating edge on the opening—admitting he knows how this looks.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、ゲームのスロット好きだろ?
lines.en: Riku, you like slot games, don't you?
lines.style: Knowing smirk underneath. Deliberate topic shift—she's angling for a reaction. Slower, more deliberate than the earlier questions. Watching him carefully.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、エッチな話題で笑わせるなよ、桜
lines.en: Don't make me laugh with weird stuff like that, Sakura.
lines.style: Embarrassed push-back wrapped in mock-stern tone. Slight laugh escaping despite himself. He's caught and he knows it. Voice lifts slightly at the end—almost pleading.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、放課後の校庭、ぼくにとって楽園だぜ
lines.en: Riku, the schoolyard after classes—that's paradise for me.
lines.style: Tone shifts to something quieter, more genuine. Slower pace. Opens up like she's admitting something she didn't plan to say. Trailing softly—like she's hearing herself and surprised by it.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、授業中ちゃんと着席しろよ、桜
lines.en: Sit properly during class, will you, Sakura?
lines.style: Softens slightly—less edge, more actual concern underneath. Not lecturing, more like he's noticing something about her. Steady, close, like he's speaking to her alone in the room.
